cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've selected our wedding video for tonight. You may choose where we start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That isn't one of the chapters. I've approved your father's speech; we never settled what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pause granted. You may choose dancing instead; no speeches there. We can finally decide whether your uncle falls into the cake.

reason: A offers controlled entertainment choices, rejects the relationship question as outside the selection, then grants surface compliance that evades B real request.
